affected_subject.reason: Identifies order book linked-list logic, _updateBookPostOrder/_updateLimitPostOrder/_updateLimitRemoveOrder, and prevOrderId field.

trigger_or_action.reason: Appending a limit order to an existing price level, then cancelling/filling/expiring it, triggers removal routine.

direct_effect.reason: Earlier orders detached and become unreachable ghost orders, locking maker collateral and inflating open interest.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected storage prevOrderId persistence vs actual memory-only update, causing removal to misclassify node as head and drop true head segment.

summary: Report concretely describes the broken prevOrderId link, the append-then-remove trigger, the resulting orphaned orders and locked collateral, and the storage-vs-memory state-transition mismatch underlying the safety violation.
